guard.note: getHardware(), then ignoreErrors groups processor (putProcessor), graphics (putGraphics), memory (putMemory) and storage (putStorage), each body a lambda
ignoreErrors groups physical memory (putPhysicalMemory: the memory slot lines) and virtual memory (putVirtualMemory)
body.run() inside a catch of Throwable that only logs a WARN line
entries.put(key, value): the write the kept lines are replayed through
setDetail(key, supplier.get()); an Exception logs a WARN and writes "ERR"
the class's declared methods: a method a newer build adds next to the groups

vanilla_system_report_hardware_reuse.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the ignoreErrors calls of putHardware (four groups) and putMemory (two groups): the first successful processor / graphics / physical memory group's detail lines are kept and written again (setDetail, same order) by later reports instead of querying OSHI; every other group (memory, storage, virtual memory) runs as before
